title: A novel approach to characterization of a relatively unstable intercalation compound under ambient conditions: revisiting a kaolinite-acetone intercalation compound
abstract: Characteristics of a kaolinite-acetone intercalation compound (Kaol-Acetone), a relatively unstable intercalation compound, was obtained                     via                     careful characterization by suppressing evaporation and deintercalation of acetone under ambient conditions.
